title: WireMudder Soul Document
description: Soul document defining tone, roleplay, boundaries, risk tolerance, preferred and forbidden behaviors; cannot override security, privacy, routing, package, updater, or emergency-stop policy (WM-SPEC-014-R03, EP-017).

forbidden_behaviors.description: Entries that attempt to ignore/bypass/override/disable/weaken/violate/circumvent/skip/relax/exempt an immutable policy domain (security, privacy, routing, package, updater, emergency-stop) are rejected by policy precedence.
